description: This file defines an abstract class 'WebOrDesktopDevice' implementing device-related functionalities such as storage management, database handling, keychain operations, and device reset methods for web or desktop environments within a larger application.

classes.name: WebOrDesktopDevice
classes.description: An abstract class providing core device functionalities for web or desktop platforms, including storage, database, keychain, and reset operations.

methods.name: setApplication
methods.description: Associates an application with the device and initializes its database.

methods.name: getJsonParsedRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw storage value by key and parses it as JSON if possible.

methods.name: clearAllDataFromDevice
methods.description: Clears all device data including keychain and storage, and deletes all associated database entries.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes all databases and clears the internal database list.

methods.name: getRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw storage value from localStorage.

methods.name: setRawStorageValue
methods.description: Sets a raw storage value in localStorage.

methods.name: removeRawStorageValue
methods.description: Removes a specific raw storage value from localStorage.

methods.name: removeAllRawStorageValues
methods.description: Clears all raw storage values from localStorage.

methods.name: openDatabase
methods.description: Opens or creates a database for a given application identifier.

methods.name: getDatabaseLoadChunks
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts database entries into chunks based on options.

methods.name: getAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Fetches all payloads from the database for a given identifier.

methods.name: getDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Retrieves specific payloads by keys from the database.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Saves a single payload to the database.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Saves multiple payloads to the database.

methods.name: removeDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specific payload from the database.

methods.name: removeAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Clears all payloads from the database for an application.

methods.name: getNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves a namespaced keychain value for an application.

methods.name: setNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets a namespaced keychain value for an application.

methods.name: clearNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Deletes a namespaced keychain value for an application.

methods.name: setRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets a raw keychain value.

methods.name: openUrl
methods.description: Opens a URL in a new browser tab.

methods.name: performSoftReset
methods.description: Reloads the current window to perform a soft reset.
